spanish: Y toda ofrenda de tu oblación con la sal salarás, y no harás cesar sal de pacto de tu Dios de sobre tu oblación; sobre toda tu ofrenda acercarás sal.
grammarChanges: Replaced the untranslated lemma 'minjá' with the Spanish common noun 'oblación' for H4503 on both tokens h03002013003 and h03002013012, per the cited fail that common nouns stay Spanish.
Changed 'con sal' to 'con la sal' for token h03002013004 (בַּמֶּלַח, preposition + article + noun), per the cited warn that the definiteness was dropped.
readerNote: Chose 'oblación' as the Spanish common noun for H4503 (מנחה) in both occurrences, distinct from 'ofrenda' used for H7133 (קרבן) elsewhere in the verse.
